title: E5: bus_read returns compact rows by default; full task only on request
spec:
The Planner's bus_read(status_not="done") returned 318k characters on 2026-09-19 (every spec, result and event of 60 tasks), the single largest token sink of a Planner turn. Change orchestrator/bus_mcp.py bus_read and orchestrator/bus.py:
1. bus.read(...) gains compact=False; bus_mcp.bus_read gains compact: bool = True and full: bool = False. With compact, each row is {id, parent, role, status, complexity, tier, title (first 90 chars), depends_on, hold_reason, reason (first 120 chars), merged_into, assigned_to, has_result (bool), result_summary (first 160 chars of result.summary when present)}. No spec, no events, no acceptance, no scope.
2. bus_read(task_id=...) returns the full task by default (one task is fine); full=True on a filter returns the old shape.
3. bus_events unchanged. Update the tool docstrings so the Planner sees how to get details. README bus section: one line.
Tests in tests/test_bus.py: compact row keys and truncation; full returns the old shape; single-task read unchanged.
acceptance: A compact row for a task with a 5,000-char spec is under 600 characters when serialized

result.summary:
Committed clean on `task/T-0211`.

**Summary:** `bus.read()` gained a `compact=False` kwarg producing trimmed rows (id, parent, role, status, complexity, tier, title[:90], depends_on, hold_reason, reason[:120], merged_into, assigned_to, has_result, result_summary[:160]) — no spec/events/acceptance/scope. `bus_mcp.bus_read` now defaults `compact=True` on filtered reads; `task_id=` or `full=True` still gives the old full shape. `bus_events` untouched.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/bus.py`, `orchestrator/bus_mcp.py`, `tests/test_bus.py`, `README.md`.

**Test output:** all 288 tests pass (`test_read_compact_rows`, `test_read_full_shape_unchanged`, `test_read_single_task_full` included), no failures. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
